  When a charge fails, retry it on days 1, 3, 7, 14 after the failure (contractual, finance policy FP-12). If the day-14 retry also fails, mark the invoice `uncollectible` and stop. Never retry an invoice that has a refund in progress.

```python
"@font-face { font-family: Inter; src: url(assets/Inter.woff2); } body { font-family: Inter; }"
```

To switch fonts, change the `@font-face` source and the `body { font-family }` rule. The stylesheet is loaded through a shared `FontConfiguration` (`_FONTS`) and passed to `write_pdf`.

Passing `base_url=` to `HTML(...)` or using an absolute path would fix that.
